svg.title: Chonks
svg.desc: A source file is cut into chunks at function boundaries, the chunks are linked by calls and name mentions, and the question "who calls load_texture()?" walks the graph to its three callers.

g.text: +1 name mention, not a proven caller
Cut the codebase into chunks at function and class boundaries
Link the chunks by calls, imports and name mentions
Ask a question, and walk the graph to the answer
Then the whole codebase: one graph in one local file
Hundreds of thousands of chunks, millions of edges, one local file
